about: The demo's scenario: the Burgohondo fire of 23 July 2026 near El Tiemblo, Ávila, replayed from real satellite hotspots. Read by backend/app/scenario.py; HACKFIRE_SCENARIO picks a scenario by id. Paths are relative to this file. See docs/setup/new-scenario.md.
name: Burgohondo fire near El Tiemblo, Ávila, 23 July 2026
scenario_time_note: 18:00 CEST: after La Atalaya is first flagged (15:30 CEST, see lead_time), with about 4 h to impact and safe ways out still open. HACKFIRE_SCENARIO_TIME overrides it.
lead_time_note: A hotspot within 3 km of the estate's outline counts as the fire reaching La Atalaya: 3 km is the pixel size of MTG, the sensor behind 62% of the hotspots. See docs/findings/2026-09-19-lead-time.md.
places_note: The zones the registry's residents belong to, drawn by pnpm data:zones from the residential land use within radius_m of each OSM node. La Atalaya: hamlet node 1433078707. El Tiemblo: village node 64835850.
